steps.title: Game screens
steps.body: Screens are the 2D layer over the game: splash, title, HUD, pause, dialogue, game over, and your own. Edit a built-in and the project keeps its own copy; Reset brings the original back.

steps.title: Add a widget
steps.body: Widgets are text, buttons, images, hearts, bars, lists, dialogue, minimap and panels. The tree is also the order keyboard and gamepad focus follow.
steps.task: With the HUD open, add a text widget.

steps.title: Show live values
steps.body: Write {name} in a text to show a value while playing: {hp}, {map.name}, {inventory.coin}, or any logic variable such as {score}. Anchors keep a widget on its edge on every screen size.
steps.task: Change the new text to show {score}.

steps.title: Every screen size
steps.body: Screens are laid out at 1280×720 and scaled to fit. Check them on a phone and a tablet frame; the hatched strips are safe areas (notches, rounded corners).
steps.task: Switch the canvas to the Phone frame.
